queries.name: AC state
queries.text:
from(bucket: "smarthouse-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "mqtt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["location_id"] == "935-CORKWOOD-AC" and r["_field"] == "state")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) * 1000.0}))

queries.name: Vibration
queries.text:
from(bucket: "smarthouse-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "mqtt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["location_id"] == "0xa4c138b53c1c52c4" and r["_field"] == "vibration")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(usePrevious: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 600.0}))

queries.name: DEH
queries.text:
from(bucket: "smarthouse-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "mqtt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["location_id"] == "DEH" and (r["_field"] == "power" or r["_field"] == "state"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._field == "state" then float(v: r._value) * 550.0 else float(v: r._value)}))
